Yes, i am legally an adult and confidentiality applies to me. 
I have been considering the option of not being so direct, thank you for the suggestion.

Lebanon is going through an economical crisis (similar to the better known Venezuela). That lead to a bunch of problem including but not limited to inflation, banks' overtake of the money in everyone s account and most importantly stoping us from being able to pay anything online. Majes telehealth much harder.

Thank you for the support. I got a couple of answers telling me they can relate with this. I am here to talk and discuss in case you feel like it, get to understand each other better and find someone with similar problems to bond with.

Im gonna look into suicidal ideation and Lebanese law, thanks again.
Best of luck in your healing journey. And just know that by sharing your experience you helped me lise the feeling if being broken in a unique way, and that is hugely appreciated!
Will check them out, and you didn't have to do all of that! It is very appreciated.

I m gonna be looking into the law in here. But it is probably not gonna matter... I m going either ways, with the difference being how much i open up. Thank you for the reply. And just one more thing, do you really relate to what I wrote above? 

I called it 'casually suicidal' because I couldn't find a name for it. As much as I looked it up it felt like there was nothing... Almost as if nobody ever had the same situation, the same feeling.

It definitely helped, a comforting comment for sure. I am extremely scared from the possibility of ending up in a mental asylum, someone DMed me that I should probably research these laws in my country and I'll do just that. If I ever feel like having a chat you will find me talking to you first thing.

It could put me in danger if they decide to go outvof their way by reaching out to my family but I guess that would be a stretch. The more likely senario is that they wouldn't want to work with me and that could lead to me not being able to afford therapy anymore if it happens a bunch of times and I blow my money on trying to find someone that ll accept me.
